item.title: Supertanker explodes after hitting mine in ‘unauthorized’ Hormuz route: IRGC Navy
item.description: Tehran, IRNA - The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC)’s Navy announced Sunday that a violating supertanker carrying crude oil suffered a powerful explosion after striking a naval mine as it was attempting to exit the Strait of Hormuz through an unauthorized route.

item.title: ‘Don’t let my friends be forgotten’: Surviving Minab student writes to Araghchi

item.title: Security chief: US response to Iran’s 7 conditions ‘insufficient’

item.title: VP: Iran documents war environmental damage for global legal pursuit
item.description: Tehran, IRNA - Vice President and Head of the Department of Environment Shina Ansari has said that documented reports on the damage inflicted on the country’s environment—including the release of pollutants, harm to biodiversity, and destruction of natural and wetland habitats—have been prepared and will be used at international environmental summits for legal pursuit.
